screen.name: Audio Attachment Recording
screen.purpose: Record an audio attachment for a task. Saving the file does not transcribe it.

waveform.unavailableWhen: the capture path has no microphone meter

excludes: capture warm-up before the first sample

behavior.onStop: Finish capture and save an audio attachment on the task. Do not call speech-to-text. While saving, ignore a second Save. On success, close this screen. If saving fails, keep the recording and let the user retry.
behavior.onCancel: Cancel is the only discard control. If meaningful audio has already been captured, ask before discarding. The confirmation offers Keep recording and Discard recording. Discard drops only this take. Previously saved attachments stay.
behavior.onPause: Stop appending audio and freeze the timer and the level meter. The button becomes Resume. Already captured audio stays.
behavior.onResume: Continue the same recording from the elapsed time already shown. Do not reset the timer.
behavior.sizeLimit: Stop and save when the captured file reaches the product audio size limit. There is no countdown and no fixed minute cap. If the device cannot continue because it is out of space or memory, say so and keep whatever audio can still be saved.
behavior.unavailableCapture: When the device can only produce uncompressed audio, this screen does not start. Title recording stays available.
behavior.transcription: Not available on this screen. Transcribe with AI is an action on the saved attachment.

starting.description: Requesting microphone access. The timer has not started.

recording.description: Audio capture is active. The timer advances and the level meter follows the microphone.

paused.description: Recording is temporarily suspended. The timer does not advance and the level meter freezes. Captured audio stays.

saving.description: Saving the audio attachment. Speech-to-text is not called. A second Save is ignored.

saved.description: The attachment exists on the task. This screen closes and the Audio attachments section shows the new recording.

error.description: Recording or saving failed. Permission and pause failures leave no new attachment. A failed save keeps the current take so the user can retry or discard it.

visualRules: Use the voiceRecorder and audioWaveform components from design-system.json.
Do not define screen-specific colors, radii or spacing.
The reference PNG is a visual target for composition and density, not a source of token values.
Do not reproduce the glowing halo from the reference. The microphone uses the thin accent ring from voiceRecorder.
The ring shows microphone activity. It is teal while recording and neutral while paused. It is not a duration countdown.
The waveform is a live level meter of about 16 bars. Do not use a decorative row of dots or a looping animation.
There is no close control in the header. Cancel under the buttons is the only discard action.
Cancel, Pause or Resume, and Save have visible labels. Save does not mean transcribe.
Leave generous space between the recorder and the buttons. Move the central group slightly down and the buttons slightly up, using spacing tokens rather than a fixed position.
Pause, the open-ended timer and save-without-transcription belong to this screen. Do not copy them into the title recorder.

reference.description: Approved composition reference for the audio attachment recorder. The halo and the decorative waveform in the image are superseded by voiceRecorder and audioWaveform.

angular.note: Opened from Add audio recording on Create Task and Edit Task. Same recorder services as title recording, with pause and without automatic transcription.
